NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone is used to practise English VHF calls (MAYDAY, PAN-PAN) in the bundled SRC course. Speech is recognized on this device when a local model is available. Audio is not sent to a server or saved.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech recognition transcribes your VHF calls on this device for SRC practice. Audio is not sent to a speech server or saved.
